summary: The remediation's format-boundary rules are not fully covered by automated end-to-end decode tests. Only EAN-13 and QR have actual decodeGtin tests; EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, and GS1 Code128 are only tested at the normalization layer or not at all.
claim: A regression in barcodeReader's POSSIBLE_FORMATS or decodeGtin could go undetected, reducing confidence that the remediation fully closes the defect across all required formats.

evidence.source: BarcodeCameraTest contains bundledDecoderReadsKnownIndexedEan13 (EAN-13 end-to-end) and numericGtinQrIsAcceptedButArbitraryQrContentIsRejected (QR end-to-end). No test calls decodeGtin with generated EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, or Code128. The provided live scan evidence only lists EAN and numeric QR, not the other accepted formats.

suggested_remediation: Add automated tests that generate and decode real barcodes for EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14, and GS1 Code128 using decodeGtin(barcodeReader(), ...), asserting acceptance/rejection according to the remediation rules.
suggested_validation: Test suite passes with new cases for each required format and rejection of non-GS1 linear formats end-to-end.
